title: A column renamed with SELECTCOLUMNS keeps its lineage
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( SELECTCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( Product[Color] ), "New name", Product[Color] ), "Amt", [Sales Amount] )

source.quote: If a column is renamed, the data lineage is still maintained
source.supports: the article's query: a renamed column still slices the measure

derivation: [New name] is a plain reference to Product[Color], so it keeps that lineage and context transition filters Product[Color]. Red is products 1 and 2: Sales rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 = 100 + 40 + 20 + 200 + 100 = 460. Blue is product 3: rows 4, 6 = 50 + 30 = 80. Green: BLANK.
